The difficulty comes from the spec placing the Vinted dense-retrieval evidence in p38; moving only that evidence to the hybrid section (keeping both invariants together, as the decision log requires) was not considered by the earlier rulings.

p79 states the one form every part compiles to, why the e-bike gain came from vocabulary and policy, and that a taxonomy release without aliases, labels and evaluation sets is a relevance regression.
p79 returns to "ebike gazelle" and "T3 balcon Lyon 7" as requests for filters.

The cold reader of the opening predicted every section in order, from the Tradeyard scene through the review questions, the scenario and documented-case evidence, and the tone; it did not name engine documentation, a minor gap.

The cold reader built one vocabulary entry with per-language aliases and the speed-pedelec exclusion read by tagger and categorizer, analyzer fixes checked on a real-query test set, categorizer labels from mapping events and backfilled attributes registered as an owned, monitored order-tier model, the 0.85 filter-with-chip and boost/suggest bands, the no-increase invariant and the ladder widening the radius before broadening the category.
